text:
Camila Reyes: :tada: Launching the **Customer Reference Program** (case studies + reference calls)

We’re formalizing how we recruit/design partners and how Sales requests reference calls so we can move faster *without* burning customer goodwill.

**What’s live today**
1) **Reference request intake + routing** (internal)
2) **Single source of truth** for who is reference-ready + any guardrails
3) **Asset folder + templates** (prep one-pager, talk track, legal checklist)

---
**How Sales requests a reference call (starting now)**
Please do *not* DM customers directly with “can you talk to this prospect?” unless CS has approved.

**Step 1 — Submit the intake form** (takes ~2 mins)
• Intake form: https://redwoodinference.internal/forms/reference-request

**Step 2 — Routing + approvals (automatic)**
• AE owner + Region lead gets notified
• CS approval required (Rachel Kim / Miguel Santos team)
• SE optional but recommended for technical prospects (Markus Klein / Simran Kaur)

**Step 3 — We schedule + prep**
• We’ll send you a calendar hold once customer confirms
• Use the prep template below so the customer gets context + we avoid sensitive topics

---
**Turnaround times / SLAs**
• **Triage:** within **1 business day** (approve / decline / request more context)
• **Scheduling:** target **3–5 business days** to get a call on the calendar (customer availability dependent)
• **Urgent deals:** tag @Rachel Kim + @Markus Klein in the intake notes and we’ll try to pull in faster, but we still need CS sign-off.

---
**Where the assets live**
• Drive (single folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/RI_GTM_Reference_Program
  - “Reference_Call_Prep_One_Pager_(Internal)”
  - “Outreach_Sequences_and_Email_Copy_(Draft)”
  - “Metrics_Validation_Worksheet_(Sheet)”
  - “Customer_Quote_Logo_Release_Form_Template”

• Confluence overview (process + governance): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SE/Customer+Reference+Program+Overview

---
**What info you must include in the intake (so we don’t bounce it back)**
• Prospect name + stage + why they’re asking
• What you want them to hear (2–3 bullets)
• Topics to avoid (security, pricing, incident history, etc.)
• Desired customer profile (deployment mode: Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

---
**Case study pipeline (public)**
If you’re asking a customer to be a *public* case study, route through Marketing first.
• Program owner: Camila Reyes
• Messaging/claims review: Soojin Lee
• Writer/interviewer: Ethan Wallace
• Legal: Michael Grant / Sofia Mendes (logo/quote release)

Jordan Blake: +1. This is a big lever for the PLG → sales-assisted motion. Please help us keep it disciplined (one process, no surprises to customers). :thumbsup:

Stephanie Nguyen: Love this. Q: for a late-stage opp, can the AE propose 2–3 potential customers in the intake? Or do we need to pick one?

Camila Reyes: You can list up to 3 in the intake. Routing will still check **reference readiness** + call frequency caps. If one is “do not contact” we’ll steer you to a better match.

Lukas Meyer: For EMEA — any difference in SLA / who owns scheduling?

Rachel Kim: Same SLA. Scheduling owner is CS (Miguel + team) but we’ll coordinate with region leads as needed for time zones. If it’s EMEA-specific compliance questions, we’ll pull in SE.

Avery Johnson: Where do we see who’s reference-ready? HubSpot field or a sheet?

Isabelle Laurent: HubSpot. We added/standardized fields this week:
• Reference readiness: Not ready / Ready (calls) / Ready (public)
• Approval status: Pending / Approved / Expired
• Guardrails: free-text (topics to avoid, frequency)

You can find it in the company record under “GTM > References”. If you don’t see it, ping me and I’ll update permissions.

Priyom Das: What’s the current expectation on how often we can ask the same customer to do calls?

Rachel Kim: Default cap is **1 call / month / customer** unless they explicitly opt into more. We’ll track it and say no if we’re over-asking.

Markus Klein: +1 on prep. Please use the one-pager and include:
• prospect stack + workload (seq lengths, streaming vs non-streaming)
• what “success” means (latency p95, throughput, cost/query)
Also: if you anticipate deep technical questions, add “SE requested” in the intake and we’ll cover you.

Hannah Schmitt: If a customer only wants to do reference calls but no logo/quotes, do we still put them in the program?

Camila Reyes: Yes. That’s a valid tier (“Ready (calls)”). Public case study is separate and requires release + approvals.

Soojin Lee: Reminder on claims: please don’t promise exact numbers in writing to prospects (“50% lower cost” etc.) unless it’s in an approved case study or we’ve validated the measurement window. If you need a safe phrasing, drop it in #marketing and we’ll help.

Tyler Benson: I’ll pin the Drive folder + Confluence page in this channel and add them to the Sales onboarding doc. Also working on a short Loom walkthrough of the intake form.

Miguel Santos: If you’re unsure whether a customer is a good fit for a call (e.g., still in rollout / recent incidents), submit anyway and we’ll triage. Better that than surprising them.

Camila Reyes: Thanks all. Please start using the intake immediately for any new requests. We’ll do a quick retro in ~2 weeks and adjust SLAs/routing based on volume. :rocket:
